title: Vasil Hard Fork and COPI to NFT | Cornucopias
description:
Vasil Hard Fork, COPI Marketplace Integration, Word Game Results and a Leak.

In this episode of COPI Cafe Josh and Rob discuss the Vasil Hard Fork and also reveal their words from last weeks word game. The guys announce that the NFT Marketplace will soon have the ability to accept COPI, as well as some great news about the in-game performance. Steve or Corn Pops joins the show to discuss his long history with Cardano. And of course the guys finish up the show with a peek inside the game.

Post your contest entries for this episode into the "Word Game" channel in Discord.

Other MUST-SEE videos: 
PVP Gameplay: https://youtu.be/Gtw3qAgaXYI 
Custom Dome Tour: https://youtu.be/aL_4dTFKyJk 
Solace Teaser: https://youtu.be/v52pdDdPzMw 

00:00 - Intro 
00:34 - Beverage Choices
02:46 - COPI Stake Pool Update
07:30 - Vasil Hard Fork
14:34 - Word Game Results
16:40 - COPI to NFT
17:49 - Racing Game in Unreal Engine 5
19:21 - In-Game Performance
20:26 - Special Guest - Steve (Corn Pops)
21:38 - Steve's Background with Cardano & Cornucopias
27:05 - Steve's Role at Cornucopias
33:34 - Community Questions
36:54 - LEAK
38:58 - Outro
39:22 - SPECIAL LEAK

#Metaverse #Cardano #CryptoCurrency #Blockchain #NFT #MetaverseGame #IOHK 

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
